memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: independent in ADLs, manages hotel duties, walks unaided.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 (negative screen).
falls: 0 falls in last 12 months, gait normal, timed up-and-go 9 seconds (normal).
medicines: 6 regular (apixaban 5 mg BD, bisoprolol 2.5 mg OD, pregabalin 75 mg BD, diclofenac 50 mg BD after food, methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD, warfarin not started). Polypharmacy – request review against Beers criteria.
mood: reports occasional low mood, denies depression.
carers: spouse, Mr. Ramesh, supportive.
goal: "Stay active at work and avoid falls."

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve been feeling occasional palpitations and lower back pain radiating to left leg, worse after long shifts at the hotel. I’m worried about falling while managing the front desk.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow‑up appointment booked for 2025-10-10 at 10:00 am with Dr Nandini Kulkarni (D06).

cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 (negative).

carers: spouse, Mr. Ramesh.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: reports occasional difficulty climbing hotel stairs, uses handrail.
cognition: Mini-Cog 3/5 (negative).
falls: 1 fall in last 12 months (tripped over rug, no injury), gait slow, timed up-and-go 13 seconds (raised fall risk) – advise exercise program and supportive footwear.
medicines: 5 regular (warfarin 6 mg OD, bisoprolol 2.5 mg OD, pregabalin 150 mg BD, diclofenac 50 mg BD after food, methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD). Polypharmacy – request Beers review.
mood: reports occasional frustration with pain, denies depression.
carers: spouse, Mr. Ramesh.
goal: "Maintain mobility to enjoy time with grandchildren."

memories.author: D06
memories.text: MRI lumbar spine: L4‑L5 disc bulge causing left L5 nerve root compression, mild canal stenosis.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Referral to Physiotherapy Department, Sunrise Family Clinic, for core strengthening, lumbar traction, and gait training. Please see patient for 6 sessions over 8 weeks.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Physiotherapy report: patient completed 6 sessions, reports 40% reduction in leg pain, improved timed up-and-go to 11 seconds. Advised to continue home exercise program and wear supportive shoes.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Allergy: aspirin – urticaria and angioedema within 30 minutes of ingestion. Avoid NSAIDs containing aspirin; diclofenac tolerated.
